680: (Shemot 20:Adonai) poked avon avot al banim al shilleshim veal ribbeim. ilana chada, deintziv chada, uteren zimnin, utelat zimnin, vearba zimnin, veitpekad al chove kadmae, av uven. shelishi urevii chad hu kad la ittakkan, vela chayish leittakna, vechen behippucha deda, leilana deihu ittakkan kadka chazi, vekaim al kiumeh (nusach acher keden) veose chesed vegomer.

(Shemot 20) la tissa, raza da ha ukemuha chavrayyay. begin dekudesha berich hu kad shatil alma, atba go tehome, tzerora chada, chakika bishma kaddisha, veatba lah lego tehoma. vechad mayya baan lesalleka, chaman raza dishma kaddisha, chakik al hahu tzerora, vetayyvin umishtakkein, vehaderin laachora, ushema da kayyeyma ad yoma da, go tehoma.
Uveshaata deomin bene nasha al keshot, bekiyyuma dikshot, hahu tzerora salleka, umekabbela hahu omaa, veahdar veitkayyaym al tehoma, vealma itkayyaym, vehahu omaa dikshot kayyaym alma.

Uveshaata deomu bene nasha omaa leshakkera, hahu tzerora salleka lekabbela lah lehahi omaa, kevan dechaze deihu deshikra. keden hahu tzerora dehava salik, tav laachora, umayin azlin veshatin, veatvavn dehahu tzerora, parchan go tehome, veitbadderan, uvaan mayya lesalleka lechafyay alma, uleahdara leh kemillekaddemin.

Ad dezammin (nusach acher daremayz) kudesha berich hu, lechad memana, yeazriel, di memana al shivin maftechan, beraza dishma kaddisha, veal legabbeh dehahu tzerora, vechakik beh atvavn kemilkaddemin, ucheden itkayyaym alma, veahadru mayin leduchetayyhu. (nusach acher dehahu tzerora varegaysh lehu laatavevan dishma kaddisha vechakik lehu kemillekaddemin veahadaru mayin leduchetayyhu ucheden itkeyyaym alma) veal da ketiv la tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav.

Raya mehemna pikkuda 12, leomaa bishmeh beorach keshot. uman deome shevua, hu kalil garmeh, beinnun 7 dargin illain, dishma dekudesha berich hu itkelil behu. veha shita innun. hahu bar nash deome omaa dikshot al pi bet din, kalil garmeh behu, vehu sheviaa, lekayyeyma shema kaddisha beducheteh. val da ketiv, (Devarim 6:13) uvishmo tishshavea. uman deome omaa lemaggena uleshakkera, garim lehahu atar dela yitkayyaym beducheteh.

Omaa lekayyeyma pikkuda demareh, da ihu shevua dikshot, kad hahu yitztzer hara mekatreg levar nash, umefatte leh lemebar al pikkuda demareh. da ihu omaa demareh ishtebach beh, veitztzetrich leh levar nash leumaa bemareh al da, vihu shevacha dileh. vekudesha berich hu mishtebach beh. kegon boaz, dichtiv, (Rut 3:13) chay Adonai shichvi ad habboker. ha yitztzer hara hava mekatreg leh, vome al da.

Neder ihu leella, vinnun chayye malka, raza dermch shayyfin, uterisar ketirin, kechusheban vneder. veal da chamir mishshevua. chayye demalka illen, deyahiv chayyin lechol illen shayyfin, vikrun hachi begin innun chayyin, veinnun chayyin nachtin meella letatta. lehahu mekora dechayyyn. umehahu mekora nachtin letatta, lechol innun shayyfin.

Shevua lekayyeyma darga diltatta, raza dishma kaddisha. vda ikre melech atztzemo, derucha illaa vegufa dileh, lemishre begavvih, uledayyeyra beh, berucha deshare go gufa. veal da ikre melech atztzemo derucha ilaa taiva dile lemishre begavi atztzemo dehahu desattir leela. uvegin kach, man deome bikshot, hu mekayyem lehahu atar, vechad kae hay atar mekuyaym, mekayyem kol alma. neder sharya al kolla, al mitztzeva, veal reshuta delav hachi bishvua, vhachi ukemuha chavrayyay. (ad kan raya mehemana) (pikkuda 13 leitasseka bifriyya ureviyya vechulei ad bechol sitrin. umishsham telech Vayikra 43 amud bet uveyom hashshemini)
681: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho da ihu raza divrit kaddisha. uvegin dibbehay berit kayymin kol mekorin deshayyfe gufa, veihu kalal kolla. kegavvna, da shabbat ihu kelala deorayyta, vechol razin deorayyta beh talyayn, vekiyyuma deshabbat, kekiyyuma dechol orayyta, man denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kulla.

Raya mehemna pikkuda 24, lemehevi dachir yom hashshabbat, kema deat amer zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. raza deshabbat, ha okimna bechol innun duchete, yoma ducherana denayycha dealma veihu kelala deorayyta. uman denatir shabbat, keillu natir orayyta kolla. veha ittemar, ducherana deshabbat, lekaddesha leh bechol zine kidushin. man deidkar lemalka, itztzetrich levarcha leh, man deidkar shabbat, tzarich lekaddesha leh veha ittemar.
Zachor lidchura ihu. shamor ihu lenukeba. (veda belo piruda) yom shabbat, raza dechol mehemanuta, detalya meresha illaa, ad sofa dechol dargin, shabbat ihu kolla.

Telat dargin innun, vechullehu ikrun shabbat. shabbat illaa. shabbat deyoma. shabbat delelya. vechullehu chad veikre kolla shabbat. vechol chad, kad ihu shalta, natil lechavroy, vezamin lon bahadeh, behahu shuletanu dileh. vechad hay ate lealma, kullehu atyayn uzeminin bahadeh.

Kad ate lelya, zamin bahadeh leshabbat dimama, vezamin leh behechaleh, veittammar bahadeh. kevan dehay atya, shabbat illaa itmeshach aleh, vchullehu genizin behechla delelya uvegin da seudata delelya chamur mibbeymama (sefer acher kadebaymamea.)

Kad ate yemama, zamin bahadeh litren illen acharanin, darga illaa vedarga tattaa, da deanhir leh, veda deitnehir minih. vecholla kachada ikre shabbat, veshaltin beyoma deshabbat. veillen telat dargin, innun kelala vraza dechol orayyta, tora shebbichtav, neviim uchetuvim. man denatir shabbat, natir orayyta kulla.
Teren margelan innun, vchad sichata bahadayyhu, begavvavyyhu, dekaim ben hay uven hay. margela illaa let beh gon, let be chezu beitgalleyay.

Hay margela, kad shaari leitgalyay, naharin, 7 atvavn gelifin, baltin venotztzetztzin uvekain bekiin vkastirin, vnaharin kol chad vechad. veinnun 7 atvavn, innun teren shemahan mechukkakin behahu margela. uveyoma deshabbat, natztzetztzin venaharin, ufatchin pitchin, venafke veshalte. veinnun 21 Yahu, mitnatztzetztze atvavn, uvintztzitztzu dilhon, alin da beda, venaharin da beda.
Vechad alin da beda, naharin da miggo da, bitren gavvnin. chad gon chivvavr, vechad gon sumak. umeinnun teren gavvnin, itavidu teren shemahan acharanin, ad desallekin atvvn lesheva shemahan.

1 Nafik venatztzitz, val beat 6, vnaharin tarvavyyhu, bitren gavvnin, vinnun teren shemahan, chad ikre Adonai, vechad ikre el, venaharin kachada. Adonai nafik vnatztzitz, veal beat Adonai venaharin tarvavyyhu, bitren gavvnin, veinnun teren shemahan, chad ikre yedod raza deelohim. vechad ikre elohim. venaharin kachada. 10 al bey, venaharin unetztzitztzin kachada, vealu da beda, venaharin tarvavyyhu, gelifin mechukkekan kachada, veinnun zakfan resha, nehirin menatztzetztzin anpin sallekin mehay sitra, umehay sitra, vinnun chad sare anpin.

Veillen teren atvavn denaharan, mitchabbekan da beda, innun Adonai Adonai motztzofotz motztzofotz, beraza ditlesar mechilan derachame. veillen teren atvvn, kad alin da beda, vechad mitchabbekan da beda, (vechad mitdabbekan da beda) zakfin resha, vnaharan umenatztzetztzan al kolla, beinnun chad sare anpin, denafkin bechol
682: Adonai deishtear, ihi salleka bishma chad, leitchabbera bahadayyhu, vihi adonay. vechol illen shemahan, baltin venotztzetztzin venafke veshalte behay yoma. kevan deillen shalte, nafak hahu margela illaa, balta menatztzetztza. umiggo netztzitztzu dilah, la itchazi bah gon.

Kad nafka, batash beillen shemahan, chad shema minnayyhu adonay, deihu sheviaa, mitatra val bemargela tattaa, veityeyshav shema achara techoteh, veihu 15. veistechar hahu margela illaa beh, umitatra hahu netztzitztzu denatztzitz, behay shema.

Levatar dechanish (nusach acher devatash) behane shemahan, nafkin minayyhu shivim anpin lechol setar, umitchabberan kullehu kachada, veitavid reticha vechurseyay chada, lehahu margela illaa, vshalta beitroy, malka bechurseyay, beyoma da, vechadde kolla. kevan dechadde kolla, yativ malka al kurseyay, vesalik beshivin anpin kurseyay, kidkamran.

Veinnun teren (teruma 132 amud alef) atvavn, sallekin venachtin, venaharin umitatrin atvvn 22, (sefer acher 24 atvavn) kelala deorayyta. batshe bitre (132 amud alef) atvavn kadmae, vesalke lechad, beshit shevatin, ulechad beshit shevatin acharanin. veillen innun 12 shevatin deyisrael illaa.

Tu, illen terin atvvn, (nusach acher kadmae sallekin) sallekin vnachtin, uvatshe bitren atvvn, desofa 26 atvvn. vsalke, chad bechamesh dargin, vechad bechamesh dargin. veillen eser amiran (sefer acher leshachlala) leachlela lechv atvvn, 12 shevatin bitrin atvvn, (sefer acher kadmae) kelala deorayyta vaesher amiran ditren atvvn desofa, ha 22 atvavn, desofa deorayyta. vraza da, yarit margela illaa, behahu kurseyay dev, vnaharin 22 atvavn.

Margela tattaa, beshaata deyativ margela illaa behahu kuresyay dev, vnaharin 22 atvvn. keden hahu margela tattaa dehu bechashocha, mistakkel behahu nehiru, bechela detukepa deinnun atvvn, deitreshim behon, deikrun adonay, ucheden itnehir vesalik hahu nehora, venatil kol innun 22 atvvn illain, vshaiv lon hahu margela begavvih, venahir nehiru denatztzitz lev evar.
Kevan dehay margela, natztzitz vshaiv leinun atvavn bahadah, keden margela illaa itmeshach bahadayyhu, veitdabbak margela bemargela, vhavi kolla chad. veda ihu raza chada detushebachta, veha okimna.

Atvvn, kad natztzetztzin mehay sitra, umehay sitra, da ihu sichata di begavvavyyhu, ben margela lemargela, keden itavidu raza dishma kaddisha demv atvvn. becholla raza dishma kaddisha dev atvvn, dirticha illaa, vecholla, hay vhay, itkere shabbat, veda ihu raza deshabbat. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Zachor raza didchura ihu, raza didchura denakit kol shayyfe dealma illaa. et yom hashshabbat, leasgaa maale shabbeta, deihu layla, veda ihu et. lekaddesho, deitzterich kedusha miggo amma kaddisha, uleitattera behu kadka chazi.

Zachor, atar delet leh shichcha, vela kayyeyma beh shichcha deha let shichcha (Bereshit 193 amud bet) baatar divrit illaa, vekol shekken leella. uletatta, it shichcha, atar deitzterich leadkera, veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 109:14) yizzacher avon avotav vegomer. veit tamman memanan, deadkeran zachyayn devar nash, vechovoy.

Velet shichcha kame kurseyay kaddisha, ma deihu kameh. uman ihu kameh. zachor. vekol shekken leella. begin decholla raza didchura ihu, vetamman itgelif raza dishma kaddisha 20. uletatta, itzterich leitkaddesha, uvamme itkaddash. bezachor, deha minneh natil kol kiddushan vechol birkan. veda, kad mitattere maale shabbeta, al amma kaddisha kedka yeot, bitzlotin uvevautin, uvesiddura dechedva.

Vei tema, zachor, la itzterich leitkaddesha, deha minneh nafkin kol kedushin dealma. lav hachi. deha da itzterich leitkaddesha bimama, veda itzterich leitkaddesha belelya, vechol kedushin natlin lon yisrael levatar, veitkaddeshan bekiddushe dekudesha berich hu.
683: (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha, bechol zine yekar, lemechode lon beovde dechashraan, kema deat amer (Mishlei 23:24) gil yagil avi tzaddik, veda ihu yekara daavoy udeimmeh.

Raya mehemna kabbed et avicha veet immecha. kabbedehu bichsut nekiyyay, dehayynu kanfe mitztzeva, (Mishlei 3:9) kabbed et Adonai mehonecha, da tora umitztzevot. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:16) orech yamim biminah bismolah vgo. deani lav ihu bar nash, ella min hattora umin hammitztzevot, ishtemoda, devatar deukemuha mare matnitin en ani ella min hattora umin hammitztzevot, deutra devar nash orayyta umitztzevot.

Uvegin da, kabbed et Adonai mehonecha, vla tishtaddel beorayyta, kede lehitgaddel bah. kema deukemuha chavrayyay, veal taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem, velo tomar ekra baavur sheyyikreuni rabbi, ella (tehillim la) gaddelu laAdonai itti. kabbed et Adonai mehonecha, keven deihu chayyayv bikara daavoy veimmeh.

Begin deihu meshuttaf mitteren tippin, deminnehon notztzar bar nash. mitippa deavuha, chivvavru deayynin, vegarmin veevarin. umitippa deimmeh, shachor di beayynin, vesaara umashcha uvisra. verabbiu leh beorayyta, veovadin tavin.

Devar nash chayyayv lelammed beno tora, dichtiv, (Devarim 6:7) veshinnantam levanecha. vei la olif leh orayyta ufikkudin, keillu avid leh pesel, uvegin da lo taase lecha fesel. veatid lihyot ben sorer umore, umevazze avuy veimmeh, vegozel minneh kamma birkan. dehoil vihu am haaretz, chashid ihu al kolla, vafillu al shefichut damim, vegiluy arayot, veavoda zara. deman deihu am haaretz. veazil laatar dela ishtemodun leh, vela yada levarcha, chashdinan leh deihu ovde avoda zara. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Kabbed et avicha kema deat amer kabbed et Adonai mehoncha. mehonecha: mimmamonecha. mehonecha: mechinnecha. bechedva deniguna, lemechode libba, deha da chedva delibba, kegavvna da nigguna dechol alma. ovadin dechashraan dehahu bera, chadde libba deavuha udeimmeh. mehonecha, mimmamonecha lechol ma deitzterichu.

Kegavvna devar nash okir lekudesha berich hu, hachi itzterich leabba uleima, begin deshuttafuta chada it lon bekudesha berich hu aleh. uchema deitzterich lemidchal lekudesha berich hu, hachi itzterich lemidchal leavuha uleimmeh, uleokir lon kachada, bechol zine yekar.

Lemaan yaarichun yamecha, begin deit yomin leella, detalyayn behu chayye bar nash behay alma. veokimna al innun yomin devar nash behahu alma leella, vechullehu kayymin kame kudesha berich hu, uvehu ishtemodan chayye devar nash.
Al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. avtachuta leithanya beaspakalarya denahara, veraza da al haadama, da aspakalarya denahara, beinnun yomin illain, denaharin miggo mabbua decholla.

May shena, beillen teren pikkudin deorayyta, dichtiv behu lemaan yaarichun yamecha, beda, uveshilluach hakken. ella teren pikkudin illen, kullehu talyayn leella. abba veima, raza dezachor veshamor kachada. uvegine kach ketiv lemaan yaarichun yamecha. uveshilluach hakken, dichtiv, (Devarim 22:7) shallach teshallach et haem veet habbanim tikkach lach lemaan yitav lach vegomer, raza dealma illaa, dela ityeyhiv beh reshu leistakkela, veitzterich leshalleach miggo sheelta veistakkeluta beh.

Veet habbanim tikkach lach, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim vegomer mikketze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. aval leella mikketze hashshamayim, shallach teshallach merayonecha lemishal.

Uveda ketiv, lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim, lemaan itav lach la ketiv, ella lemaan yitav lach. veyaarichun yamecha la ketiv, ella vehaarachta yamim. lemaan yitav lach, hahu atar deotiv lecholla, veihu alma desatim veganiz. vehaarachta
684: Yamim, kema dichtiv, tikkach lach, birshuta devar nash ihu.

Vei izdaman leh ovada vichavvevn beh, zakkaa ihu. veaf al gav dela mechavven beh, zakkaa ihu, deavid pikkuda demareh. aval la itchashiv keman deavid reuta lishmah, vichavven beh, biruta deistakkeluta bikare demareh, keman dela yada lemisbar sevara, deha biruta talya milla lishmah. uveovada diltatta lishmah, istallak ovada leella, veittakkan kadka yeot.

Kegavvna da, beovada degufa, ittakkan ovada denafsha, behahu reuta. deha kudesha berich hu bae libba, ureuta devar nash. vaafillu hachi, i lav tamman reuta delibba deihu ikara decholla, al da tzalle david veamar, (Tehillim 90:17) umaase yadenu konna alenu vegomer. deha let kol bar nash chakkim, leshavvaa reuta velibba, letakkena kolla veyavid ovada demitzva. al da tzalle tzelota da, umaase yadenu konna alenu.

May konna alenu. konna, veatkin tikkunach leella kadka yeot. alenu, af al gav delet anan yade leshavvaa reuta, ella ovada bilchodoy. maase yadenu konnehu. leman. lehahu darga deitzterich leittakna. konnehu, bechibbura chada baavahan, lemeheve metatkena behon, behay ovada, kedka yeot.

(Shemot 20) lo tirtzach. lo tinaf. lo tignov. lo. paska taama bechol hani telat. vei la defaska taama, la have tikkuna lealmin, viyhe asir lan lekatla nafsha bealma, af al gav deyaavor al orayyta. aval bema defaska taama, asir, veshare.

Lo tinaf. i lav defaska taama, asir afillu leolada, o lemechode beitteteh chedva demitzva. uvamme defaska taama, asir veshare. lo tignov. i lav defaska taama, hava asir afillu lemignav data derabbeh beorayyta. o data dechacham, leistakkela beh. o dayyayna dedain dina lefum taana, deitzterich leh lemignav data derammaa, ulemignav data detarvavyyhu, leappaka dina linhora. uvamme defaska taama, asir veshare.

(Shemot 20:13) lo taane vereacha ed shaker. hacha la paska taama, begin deasir hu kelal kelal. uvechol mile deorayyta, kudesha berich hu shavi razin illain, veolif livne nasha archa, leittakna bah, ulemehach bah. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 48:17) ani Adonai elohecha melammedcha lehoil madrichcha bederech telech.

Uf hachi, (Shemot 20) lo tachmod, la pasik taama kelal. vei tema, afillu chimmuda deorayyta asir, kevan dela paska. ta chaze, bechullehu avdat orayyta kelal, uvehay avdat perat. bet reecha sadehu veavdo vegomer, bechol mile dealma. aval orayyta, ihi chamudat tadir, shaashuim, ginze dechayye, arka deyomin, bealma den uvealma deate.

Hane eser amiran deorayyta, innun kelala dechol pikkude orayyta, kelala deella vetatta, kelala dechol eser amiran divreshit. illen itchekaku al luche avanin, vechol ginzin dahavo behu, itchazun leenehon decholla, leminda uleistakkela beraza detryg pikkudin deorayyta dichlilan behu, kolla itchaze leayynin, kolla ihu besachletanu, leistakkela belibba deyisrael kullehu, vecholla hava nahir leenayyhu.
Behahu shaata, kol razin deorayyta, vechol razin illain vetattain, la ade minayyhu. begin dahavo
685: Chaman ena beena, ziv yekara demarihon, ma dela hava kehahu yoma, miyyoma deitbere alma, dekudesha berich hu itgele bikareh al tura desinay.

Vei tema, ha tanenan dechamat shifcha al hayyam, ma dela chama yechezkel nevia, yachol kehahu yoma dekaimu yisrael al tura desinay. lav hachi. begin dehahu yoma dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay, abar zuhama minnayyhu, vechol gufin havo metzachtzechan, ketzachtzecha demalachin illain, kad mitlabbeshan bilvushe metzachtzechan, lemebad shelichuta demarehon.

Uvehahu malbusha metzachtzecha, alin leeshsha, vela dachalin. kegavvna dehahu malacha demanoach, kad itchaze leh, veal beshalhova, vesalik lishmayya, dichtiv, (Shoftim 13:20) vayyaal malach Adonai belahav hammizbeach. vechad abar minayyhu hahu zuhama, ishtaaru yisrael gufin metzuchetzachin belo tinnufa kelal, venishmatin lego kezohara dirkia, lekabbela nehora.

Hachi havo yisrael, dahavo chaman umistakkelan go yekara demarihon, ma dela havi hachi al yamma, dela itavar zuhama minnayyhu behahu zimna. vehacha besinay defaska zuhama miggufa, afillu ubbarin devime iman, havo chaman umistakkelan bikare demarehon. vechullehu kabbilu kol chad vechad, kadka chazi leh.

Vehahu yoma, hava chedva kame kudesha berich hu, yattir miyyoma deitbere alma, begin deyoma deitbere alma, la hava bekiyyuma, ad dekabbilu yisrael orayyta, dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam velayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti.

Kevn dekabbilu yisrael orayyta al tura desinay, keden itbassam alma, veitkeyaymu shemayya veara, veishtemoda kudesha berich hu ella vetatta, veistallak bikareh al kolla. veal hahu yoma ketiv (Tehillim 93:1) Adonai malach geut lavesh lavesh Adonai oz hitazzar. veen oz, ella tora. shenneemar (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten Adonai yevarech et ammo beshalom.
686: Sava nachat legabbeh, amar leh, i hachi, rabbi, ma tosefet lenishmeta deihi minnah, deittemar bah, (Shemot 20:10) lo taase chol melacha atta uvincha uvitecha veavdecha vegomer.

Amar leh, sava sava, veat shail da, devadday hay al nishmeta detzaddik ittemar, deaf al gav deitchayyayv leachata begilgula bechol illen, afillu beeved veama, uveiran deinnun ofannim, o bechol chevan, deminnehon nishmatin divni nasha, ketiv bah lo taase chol melacha. vehay ihu, (Vayikra 25:39) lo taavod bo avodat aved, betzadik deihu yom hashshabbat, lo taavod bo avodat aved, deihu yom dechol.

Aval sava sava, shabbat (davar acher nishmeta) deihi bat yechida, veihi bat zugeh detzaddik, deihu shabbat. may im acheret yikkach lo. amar leh ha vaday havedala, chulo shel shabbat, deit achara dela itkeriat chulo shel shabbat, ella chulo shel tuma shifcha. amar leh. veha chulo shel shabbat may hi. amar leh, da amata, deihi gufa devat yechida dealah ittemar, im acheret yikkach lo.

Ta chazi, nishmeta it deitkeriat ama, veit (nishmeta) shechinta deitkeriat shifcha, (venishmeta) veshchinta it deitkeriat berata demalka. hacha it ish, deittemar beh (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama. veit ish, deittemar beh (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel.

Uvegin da, nishmeta deihi michayyva begilgul, im hi berata dekudesha berich hu, i tema deizdevan begufa nucheraa, detamman shultanuta deyetzer hara deihu missitra desamael. chas veshalom. deha ketiv, (Yeshayahu 42:8) ani Adonai hu shemi uchevodi leacher lo etten deihu yetzer hara.

Vehahu gufa, desharya berata demalka, i tema deizdevan bechitrin tattain dimsaavu, chalila vechas. alah ittemar (Vayikra 25:23) vehaaretz lo timmacher litzmitut ki li haaretz. man gufa divrata demalka. da metatron. vehay gufa ihu ama dishchinta, af al gav deihi nishmeta deihi berata demalka shevuya tamman, begilgula atya deatyayn gilgulin begin deattit tamman, ma ketiv bah (Shemot 21:7) vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim.

Veod vechi yimkor ish, da kudesha berich hu. et bitto: ellu yisrael, deinnun missitra devat yechida, itkeriu bitto. vei tema deyifkun, kegavvna deilen missitra deeved, deihu metatron, denafku bimnusa mimmitzrayim, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:12) ki lo bechippazon tetzeu uvimnusa lo telechun.

Ta chazi, bar nash kad ityelid, (Vayikra 224 amud bet) yahavin leh nafsha missitra divira, missitra dedachyu, missitra deillen deitkerun ofanne hakkodesh. zacha yattir, yahavin leh rucha, missitra dechayyot hakkodesh. zacha yattir, yahavin leh nishmeta, missitra dechurseyay. utelat illen, innun ama eved veshifcha divrata demalka.

Zacha yattir, yahavin leh nafsha beorach atzilut, missitra devat yechida, veitkeriat ihi bat melech. zacha yattir, yahavin leh rucha deatzilut. missitra deammuda deemtzaita, veikre ben lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. zacha yattir, yahavin leh nishmeta, missitra deabba veima. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim. may chayyim. ella innun 15, dealayyhu ittemar, (Tehillim 150:6) kol hanneshama tehallel yah, veishtelim beh Adonai.

Zacha yattir, yahavin leh Adonai bishlimu deatvavn, yod hei vav hei, deihu adam, beorach atzilut deella, veitkere bediyyukena demareh. vealeh ittemar, (Bereshit 1:28) uredu bidgat hayyam vegomer. vehay ihu shuletanuteh bechol rekiin, uvechol ofannim userafim vechevavn, uvechol chayyaylin vetukefin dilella vetatta. uvegin da, kad bar nash zache benefesh missitra devat yechida, ittemar beh, lo tetze ketzet haavadim.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yosi iarau chad lelya bemigdal detzor. itarachu tamman vechaddu da beda. amar rabbi yosi, kamma chaddena dachamena anpe shechinta, dehashta bechol archa da, itztaarna bachada sava, tayyaya, dehava shail li
687: Man hu nechasha, defarach baavira, veazil befiruda, uven kach uven kach, it nayycha lechad nemala, deshachiv ben shinnoy. share bechibbura vesiyyem befiruda. umay ihu nishra, deka mekannena, beilan dela hava. benoy deitgezalu, velav min biryayn. deitberiu baatar dela itberiu. kad sallekin nachtin, kad nachtin sallekin. teren deinnun chad, vechad deinnun telata. mahu ulemta shappirta, velet lah eynin, vegufa temirta veitgalya, ihi nafkat betzafra, veitkassiat bimama. itkashtat bekishshutin dela havo.

Kol da shail bearcha, veitztaarna. vehasheta it li nayycha. deillu havena kachada, itasakna bemille deorayyta, ma dahavenan bemillin acharanin detohu. amar rabbi chiyyay, vehahu sava tayyaya, yadat beh kelum. amar leh, yadana, delet mammashu bemilloy. deillu hava yada, yiftach beorayyta, vela hava archa berekanayyay. amar rabbi chiyyay, vehahu tayyaya it hacha, deha lezimnin beinnun rekanin, yishkach gevar zaggin dedahava. amar leh, ha hacha ihu, veatkin chamareh bemechla.
Karu leh, veata lekamayyhu. amar lon, hasheta teren innun telat, utelat innun kechad. amar rabbi yosi, la amena lach, dechol milloy rekanin, veinnun berekanayyay, yativ kamayyhu.

Amar lon rabbanan, ana tayyaya itavidna, umiyyomin zeirin, deha bekadmita la havena tayyaya, aval bera chad zeira it li, veyahavit leh beve sifra, uvaena deyishtaddal beorayyta. vechad ana ashkachna chad merabbanan deazil bearcha, ana tain avatreh, vehay yoma, chashivna deeshma millin chadtin beorayyta, vela shemana midi.
Amar Rabbi yosi, bechol millin deshamana dekaamart, la tavavhna, ella mechad. o ant bishttuta amart, o millin rekanin innun. amar hahu sava, uman ihi. amar ulemta shappirta vechulei.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Tehillim 118:6-7) Adonai li la ira ma yaase li adam. Adonai li beozray vegomer. tov lachasot baAdonai vegomer. kamma tavin uneimin veyakkirin veillain millin deorayyta, vaana hechi ema kame rabbanan, dela shemana mippumayyhu ad hasheta, afillu milla chada. aval it li lememar, deha let kissufa kelal lememar mille deorayyta kame kolla.

Itattaf hahu sava, patach veamar, (Vayikra 22:12) uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel. hay kera, akra achara samich, (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel vechol zar lo yochal bo. hane kerae kemashmaan. aval millin deorayyta millin setimin innun

Vechamma innun millin dechachmeta distimin bechol milla umilla deorayyta, veishtemodan, innun legabbe chakkimin, deyadin archin deorayyta. deha orayyta lav millin dechelma innun, deka itmasran leman defashar lon, veitmashshechan batar puma, veim kol da itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy. uma i millin dechelma itzterichu lemifshar lon lefum archoy, millin deorayyta deinnun shaashuin demalka kaddisha, al achat kamma vechamma deitzterichu lemehach beorach keshot behu, dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vegomer.

Hasheta it lememar, uvat kohen, da nishmeta illaa, berateh deavraham avinu kadmaa laggiyyorin, veihu mashich, lah lehay nishmeta meatar illaa. ma ben kera deamar uvat ish kohen, uven kera deamar uvat kohen, vela ketiv ish. ella, it kohen deikre ish kohen, velo kohen mammash. veal archa da, hava (ish) kohen, vahava segan, vahava kohen gadol, vahava kohen delav ihu gadol. kohen setam, rav veillaa yattir meish kohen. veal da it nishmeta,
688: Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar, da nishmeta kaddisha, deitmashshechat meatar illaa, vealat lego setimu deilana dechayye. vechad rucha dechahana illaa nashva, veyahiv nishmatin beilana da, parchin mittamman innun nishmatin, vealin beotzar chad.

Vavy lealma, dela yadin bene nasha leistammera, deka mashchin meshichu bahade yetzer hara, deihu ish zar, vehay bat kohen parchat letatta, veashkechat binyayna beish zar. uvegin deihu reuta demara, alat tamman veitkafiat, vela yachilat leshalletaa, vela ishtallimat behay alma. kad nafkat minneh, hi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel, kishar kol nishmatin, deishtelimu behay alma.

Tu it behay kera, uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar. aluvata ihi nishmeta kaddisha, ki tihye leish zar, deka itmashshechat, al giyyora deitgeyayr, ufarchat aleh miggan eden beorach satim, al binyayna deitbeni mearla misava, da havat leish zar.

Veda hu raza illaa yetera mikkolla. beammuda dekayyeyma letiklin, go avira denashvat, it tikla chada behay sitra, veit tikla achara behay sitra. behay sitra mozni tzedek. uvehay sitra mozne mirma. vehay tikla, la shachich lealmin, venishmatin sallekin venachtin alin vetavin, veit nishmatin ashikin, kad shalta adam beadam, dichtiv, (Kohelet 8:9) et asher shalat haadam beadam lera lo, lera lo vadday.

Aval hay nishmeta, dahavat lesitra achara, ish zar, veitashshekat minneh, da ihi lera lo. lo: lehahu ish zar, veihi bitrumat hakkodashim lo tochel, ad deavid bah kudesha berich hu ma deavid, ata kera veamar uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hachi hu.

Hacha it raza, hech mitashshekan nishmatin. ella hay alma itnehag kolla, beilana dedaat tov vara. vechad itnahagan bene alma besitra detov, tikla kayyeyma veachra lesitra detov. vechad itnahagan besitra dera, achra lehahu sitra. vechol nishmatin dahavo behahi shaata betikla, hava ashik lon, venatil lon.

Aval lera lo, deinnun nishmatin kafyayn (sefer acher chafyayn) lechol ma deashkechan missitra bisha, veshaytzan leh. vesimana leda, arona kaddisha, deitashak go pelishtim, ushelitu beh, lera lon. uf hachi. hane nishmatin iteshakin missitra achara lera lon.

Ma itavidu meinnun nishmatin. chamenan besifre kadmae, deminnayyhu havo innun chaside umot haolam. veinnun mamzere talmide chachamim, dekadman lechahana rabba amma deara, vechashuv bealma, af al gav deal lifnay velifnim. bacha hay sava riga chada, tavvhu chavrayyay, vela amru midi.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 21:8) im raa beene adonyha asher lo yeadah vehefdah leam nachri vegomer. hay parsheta al raza da ittemar, vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama lo tetze ketzet haavadim im raa vegomer. mareh dealma man la yidchal minach, deant shalit al kol malchin dealma, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vegomer.

Kamma innun bene nasha bealma, deka mishtabbeshan behay kera, vechullehu amri, aval kera da la ityayshshar befumayyhu. vechi kudesha berich hu melech haggoyim ihu, vahalo melech yisrael ihu, vehachi ikre, deha ketiv, (Devarim 32) behanechel elyon goyim vegomer. uchetiv (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. veal da ikre melech yisrael. vei tema deihu melech haggoyim ikre, ha shevacha dilhon dekudesha berich hu melech alayyhu, vela kema deamrin deitmasrin leshammashin velimmanan dileh.
Vetu sefa dikra, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) ki bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha. kol hay, shevacha ihu lishar ammin, utevavha ihu, hech la mistalleke behay kera lerum
689: Rekia. ella, dekudesha berich hu sama enayyhu, vela yade beh kelal, deha ma daanan amre dechullehu ayin, vaefes, vatohu. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:17) kol haggoyim keayin negdo meefes vatohu nechshevu lo, ha ikara illaa rabba veyakkira shave lon kera da.

Amar leh Rabbi chiyyay veha ketiv (Tehillim 47:9) malach elohim al goyim vegomer. amar leh, ana chamena devatar kotlayyhu havit, venafkat behay kera lesayyeya lon, hava li leatava bekadmita, al ma daamena. aval kevan deashkachna lach bearcha, abar lach mittamman, umittamman ehach leabera kolla.

Ta chaze, kol shemahan, vechol kinnuyayn dishmahan, deit leh lekudesha berich hu, kullehu mitpashshetan learchayyhu, vechullehu mitlabbeshin illen beillen, vechullehu mitpalgin learchin ushevilin yedian. bar shema yechidaa, barir dechol shear shemahan, deachasin leamma yechidaa, barir mikkol shear ammin, veihu yod hei vav hei, dichtiv, (Devarim 32) ki chelek Adonai ammo. uchetiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai bishma da mammash, yattir mikkol shear shemahan.

Ushema chad mikkol shear shemahan dileh, hahu deitpeshat veitpelag lechamma archin ushevilin, veikre elohim. veachasin shema da, veitpelag letattae dehay alma, veitpelag shema da, leshammashin velimmanan dimnahage lishar ammin. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 22:20) vayyavo elohim el bilam layla. (Bereshit 20:3) vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayla. vechen kol memana umemanna deachasin lon kudesha berich hu lishar ammin, bishma da kelilan. vaafillu avoda zara bishma da ikre. ushema da malach al goyim, vela hahu shema, da hahu demalach al yisrael, deihu yechidaa, leamma yechidaa, leamma deyisrael, amma kaddisha.

Vei tema, al archa da nokim kera dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi la yiraacha melech haggoyim, deda ihu shema deka malach al goyim, elohim deha dechilu beh sharya vedina beh sharya. lav hachi, velav al da ittemar, dei hachi afillu avoda zara bichlala da ihu.

Aval kevan dechotala dahavet samich avatreh, itnesach, kera kaim al kiyyuma, beistakkeluta zeer. mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim, vei tema demelech haggoyim al kudesha berich hu ittemar, lav hachi. ella, man hu melech haggoyim dela yiraacha, dela dachil minach, vela yizdaza minach. mi melech haggoyim dela yiraacha. kegavvna da (Tehillim 113:1) haleluyah halelu avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. man dishma leh, la yada may kaamar, kevan deamar haleluyah, uf hachi halelu avde Adonai, dehava leh lemichtav, avde Adonai halelu et shem Adonai. uf hacha. hava leh lemichtav, mi mimmelech haggoyim dela yiraacha. ella kolla al tekkuneh ittemar.

Ki vechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam meen kamocha, mahu milla deitpashshat benayyhu bechachmeta dillehon, meen kamocha vechullehu odan al da, kad chaman bechachmeta dilhon ovadach ugevuretach, itpashat milla da benayyhu, veamre meen kamocha bechol chachme haggoyim uvechol malchutam. meen kamocha amre, veitpashshat benayyhu. chaddu chavrayyay, uvachu vela amru midi. uf hachi bacha ihu kemillekaddemin.

Patach veamar (Bereshit 21:10) vattomer leavraham garesh haama hazzot veet benah vegomer, chavrayyay ittearu, devaat sara lefannaa avoda zara mibbeta, veal da ketiv kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah. hacha ketiv vechi yimkor ish et bitto, da nishmeta begilgule al ovadin bishin dealma. leama: hahu sitra achara begilgula bisha detikla, deahadar, veha itashshekat, leappaka lah mittamman. vadday lo tetze ketzet haavadim, kol innun nishmatin demitashshekan.

Man innun hacha. ihu raza, illen innun nishmatin dinokin zeirin, kad innun yanke miggo tukepa deimmehon. vekudesha berich hu chame, dei yitkayyeymun bealma, yevaashun rechehon, veyachmetzun kechometz da. lakit lon (248 amud bet, 249 amud bet) zeirin, beod deyahave recha.
Ma avid. shavik lon leitashsheka bida dehahi ama, veda ihi lilit dechevan
690: Deityeyhivu birshutah, chaddat (nusach acher achada) behahu yenoka, vaashikat leh, veappikat leh mealma, kad ihu yanik betukepa deimmeh.

Vei tema, innun nishmatin deyaavdun tav lealma. lav hachi. dichtiv im raa beene adoneha, deyachamitz hahu gavra bah levatar yomin, i itkayyaym bah. da itashkat, veachara la itashshekat. veal illen ketiv, (Kohelet 4:1) vaere et kol haashukim vegomer vehayeynu im raa beene adoneha.
Asher lo yeadah, lo bealef ketiv. i tema, deha behahu sitra achara, azmin lah kudesha berich hu miyyoma dahavat. la. vehasheta begilgule tikla, lo yeadah beVav. ma dela havat mikkadmat dena.

Vehefdah, may vehefdah. parik lah kudesha berich hu hasheta, desalleka recha, ad la tachamitz, vesalik lah lerume meromim, (113 amud bet) bimtivta dileh, vei tema kevan deitashshekat mehahu sitra achara, yahiv lah, kema deamru lachaside (205 amud bet) shear ammin, uleinnun mamzere ta chaze. ata kera veochach, leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah vadday, bevigdo vah, deashik lah baashiku degilgula detikla, ella leyisrael vadday, vela leachara. vechad nafkat min tikla, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, ella mitattera beitteraha baarama al resheh.

Vei tema, dehay sitra alat lah behahu yannuka. lav hachi. ella natlat lah, vechaddat bahadah, ufarchat min yedaha, vealat behahu atar, veihi pekidat lehahu yenoka, vechaddat beh, vechayyeychat beh, vetaivat (58, 65 amud alef) lehahu basar, ad dilvatar natil kudesha berich hu nishmateh, vehi legufa. ulevatar kolla ihu birshuta dekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, (Shemot 21:7) lo tetze ketzet haavadim, may hu. ella, beshaata denafkat min tikla vehahu sitra bechedu, rashim lah lekudesha berich hu, vechatim lah bechad gushepanka, ufaris alah levush yekar dileh, uman ihu. shema kaddisha deikre eloah. veda hu bevigdo vah, levusha yakkira demalka paris alah ucheden ihi netira, dela itmasserat leam nachri, ella leyisrael lechud.

Veda ihu dichtiv, (Iyov 29:2) kime eloah yishmereni, veal raza da ketiv hacha, leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah, beod dilvush yekar demalka bah. kevan (Bereshit 94 amud alef, Shemot 172 amud bet, Vayikra amud bet amud bet) devigdo vah, ketiv leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah.

Ma reshu it lehahu sitra bah. ta chaze, kol bene alma kullehu, birshuteh demalka kaddisha, vechullehu it lon zimna behay alma, ad deihu bae lesalleka lon min alma, veda let leh zimna, veal da ihi chayychat behu, vechaddat behu.

Tu, azharuta levar nash (behay alma) it behane kerae, vechamma etin tavin illain innun, bechol mile deorayyta, vechullehu keshot, beorach keshot, veishtemodan legabbe chakkimin, deyade veazle beorach keshot. bezimna devaa kudesha berich hu lemivre alma, salik biruta kameh, vetziyyer kol nishmatin deinnun zeminin lemehav bivni nasha levatar, vechullehu ittzeyyayru kameh behahu tziyyura mammash, dizminin lemeheve bivni nasha levatar, vechama kol chad vechad.

Veit minnehon dizminin leavasha archayyhu bealma, uveshaata demata zimnayyhu, kare kudesha berich hu lehahi nishmeta, amar lah, zili uli bedoch pelan. beguf pelan. ativat kameh, mareh dealma, day li bealma da daana yatva beh, vela ehach lealma achara, deyishtabedun bi, veehe meluchelcha benayyhu. amar lah kudesha berich hu, min yoma deitberiat, al da itberiat lemehve behahu alma. kevan dechamat nishmeta kach, beal karchah nachtat vealat tamman.

Orayyta deyahivat eta lechol alma chamat hachi, azhirat livne alma, veamrat, chamu kamma chas kudesha berich hu alayychu, margalita tava dahavat leh, zabbin lechu lemaggana, detishtabedun bah behay alma.
Vechi yimkor ish: da kudesha berich hu. et bitto: da nishmeta kaddisha. leama: lemeheve ama mishtabeda benayychu
691: Behay alma. bematu minnayychu, beshaata demate zimna lenafka mehay alma, lo tetze ketzet haavadim, la tippuk mittannefa bechovin, tippuk bat chorin, berira nekiyya, begin deyechede bah marah veyishtabbach bah veyahiv lah agar tav, betzichtzuche deginta deeden. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha, vadday kad tippuk berira nekiyya kedka yeot.

Aval im raa beeni adoneha, kad nafkat meluchelacha betinufe chovin, vela itchaziat kameh kedka yeot, vavy lehahu gufa, deitavid mehahi nishmeta lealmin. begin, dechad nishmatin sallekin beriran, venafkin nekiyyin mehay alma, kol nishmeta venishmeta, alat besifra (338 156 amud bet) deachmata demalka, vechullehu bishmahan, veamar da hi nishmeta diflanya, zeminat tehe lehahu gufa deshavkat, ucheden ketiv, lo yeadah, bev.

Vechad nafkat raa beene adoneha, deka isteava bechovin, uvetinnufa dechattain, keden lo yeadah be. veitavid hahu gufa minah veihi la izdammenat legabbeh bar hahi demarah itree, vetav betiuveta degufa bah, keden ketiv, vehefda. kema deat amer (Iyov 33) fada nafsho meavor bashshachat. vehefdah, hay ihu bevar nash, deeta dileh, deyifrok lah, veyetuv betiuveta, velitren sitrin kaamar kudesha berich hu, vehefdah betiuveta. levatar detav betiuveta, pada lah mearcha degehinnam.

Leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah. man am nachri. aluvata ihi nishmeta, dechad nafkat mealma, uvar nash aste archeh bahadah, hi baat lesalleka leella, go mashreyayn kaddishin, begin demashreyayn kaddishin kayymin behahu archa degan eden, umashreyayn nucherain kayymin behahu archa degehinnam.

Zachta nishmeta, vehahu netiru, uferisu dilvusha yakkira alah. kamma mashreyayn kaddishin, ka mitattedan lah, leitchabbera bahadah, ulemeal lah legan eden. lo zachta, kamma mashyyryan nucherain mitattedan lemeal lah bearcha degehinnam. veinnun mashreyayn demalache chabbala zeminin lemebad bah nukemin, ata kera veochach, leam nachri lo yimsol lemachrah, illen malache chabbala. bevigdo vah, ihu netira, dekudesha berich hu avid lah netira, dela yishlot bah am nachri, behahu perisu dintiru alla.

(Shemot 21:9) veim livno yiadenna, ta chaze kamma it leh lebar nash leizdahara dela yiste archoy behay alma, dei zacha bar nash behay alma, venatir lah lenishmeta kedka yeot, hay ihu bar nash dekudesha berich hu itree beh, veishtavach beh bechol yomayya, befamalyay dileh, veamar, chamu bera kaddisha deit li behahu alma, kach vechach avid, kach vechach ovadoy mittakkenan.

Vechad hay nishmeta, nafkat mehay alma, zachyay nekiyyay berira, kudesha berich hu anhir lah bechamma nehorin, bechol yoma kare alah, da hi nishmeta diflanya beri, netira lihavi leh lehahu gufa deshavak.

Veda hu dichtiv, veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah, may kemishpat habbanot. hacha it raza lechakkimin, bego tinara takkifa, rekia temira, it hechala chada, deikre hechal ahava. (146 amud alef) vetamman innun ginzin temirin, vechol neshikin dirchimu demalka innun tamman, veinnun nishmatin rechiman demalka alin tamman.

Kevan demalka al behahu hechala demalka, tamman ketiv, (Bereshit 29:11) vayyishshak yaakov lerachel, vekudesha berich hu ashkach tamman lehahi nishmeta kaddisha, kadim miyyad venashik lah, vegafif lah, vesalik lah bahadeh, veishtaasha bah.

Veda hu kemishpat habbanot yaase lah, kedina deabba avid livrateh, deihi chaviva legabbeh, denashik lah, vegafif lah, veyahiv lah matnan. kach kudesha berich hu avid, lenishmeta zakkaa bechol yoma, kema dechtiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah.

Hayeynu dechtiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) yaase limchakke lo, kema dehay berata, ashlimat asiyyay behay alma. uf hachi kudesha berich hu ashlim lah asiyyay achara bealma deate, dechtiv, ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. vehacha ketiv
692: Yaase lah. al ken. hahu sava ishtattach, vetzalle tzelota. bacha kemilkaddemin.

Veamar (Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo vegomer, may im acheret, vechi nishmeta achara zammin kudesha berich hu leatava letzaddikayyay behay alma, velav hay nishmeta deashlimat behay alma reuta demarah, i hachi let avtachuta letzaddikayyay kelal. may im acheret yikkach lo.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Kohelet 12:7) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. hay kera ukemuha chavrayyay, becharban be makdesha. (vetamman tanenan) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya. hacha ihu may dechtiv, (Bereshit 12:6) vehakkenaani az baartz, keshehaya vadday. veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah, may veharuach tashuv. da shechinta, deihi ruach kaddisha. kad chamat shechinta, beinun eser massaot deka natla, vela baun yisrael leatava bityuveta kame kudesha berich hu, veshalta sitra achara al ara kaddisha, veukemuha chavrayyay.

Ta chazi, rucha devar nash zakkaa, itattar bediyyukena began eden diltatta, uvechol shabbate umoade vereshe yarche, mitatteran ruche, umitpashshetan, vesallekin leella. kemma deavid kudesha berich hu, behahi nishmeta illaa kaddisha leella, hachi name avid behay rucha, letatta began eden letatta, deka salkat kameh. veamar da ihi rucha diflanya gufa, miyyad meattera lah kudesha berich hu lehay rucha bechamma itrin, veishtaasha bah.
Vei tema, deha begin rucha da, shavik kudesha berich hu ma deavid lenishmeta. lav hachi. ella sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra, illen innun telat shemahan illain, deayin la raata elohim zulatcha.

Vechullehu bealma deate veitmashshechu mittamman. chad minnayyhu sheerah, meshichu dintzitzu unehiru, denahir beorach satim, mezona (lan) dezan kolla, veikre Adonai binkudat elohim. sheerah behippuch atvavn, asher Adonai veda (Bereshit 49:20) measher shemmena lachmo, veda hu sheerah.
Kesutah: perisu demalka. da meshichu achara, denahir venatir lah tadir, ferisu dilvusha demalka, defaris alah eloah. da bevigdo vah tadir, dela itade minnah, vehay ihu kesutah.

Veonatah, man ihu. da meshichu dealma deate, deveh kolla. Adonai tzevaot ihu, veda ihu denahir bechol nehorin setimin illain deilana dechayye, deveh ona temira, demittamman nafkat. vechol da beidduna vechissufa dealma deate.

Telata hane lo yigra lah, kad ihi zakkat kaddeka yeut. vei lav ihi kadka yeut, hane telata garan minah, dela yitavid lah attara afillu mechad minnayyhu, ta chazi, ma ketiv, veim shelash elle lo yaase lah, dela zachat behu, veyatza chinnam en kasef tippuk mikkameh, vedachyayn lah levar. en kasef, let lah kissufa, velet lah idduna kelal.

Ad kan ochichat orayyta, dechol etin bah talyayn, veyahivat eta tava livni nasha. mikkan ulehala nehdar lemillin kadmain, behahu netiru illaa, deka paris alah kudesha berich hu, begin dela tehe leam nachri, deha bigdo vah, unetiru ihu lah tadir.

(Shemot 21:9) veim livno yiadenna kemishpat habbanot yaase lah. amar hahu sava, chavrayyay, kad tahachun legabbe hahu tinara dealma samich aleh, imru leh, deyidkar yoma detalga deizderau polin lechamshin uteren gavvnin, vahadar akrenan hay kera, vehu yema lechon.

Amru bematu minach man deshari milla hu yema. amar lon, vadday deyadana dezakkain attun, veit lerammeza lechun remaza dechakkimin, veal ma daana ema, kad tidkerun leh simana da, hu yashlim al da. hasheta it lomar, man hu deikre ben lekudesha berich hu.
693: Hahu dezache (101 amud alef, 113 amud alef) litlesar shenin ulehala, ikre ben likkeneset yisrael. vechol man deihu mibben esrin shenin uleela vezache behu, ikre ben lekudesha berich hu vadday (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Kad mata david litlesar shenin, vezacha behahu yoma deal learbesar, keden ketiv, (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha. may tama. deha mikkadmat dena la hava leh bera, vela sharat aleh nishmeta illaa, deha bishne arla hava, uvegin kach, (128 amud bet) ani hayyom yelidticha, hayyom vadday yelidticha. ani, vela sitra achara, kema dehava ad hasheta, ani bilchoday. bar esrin shenin, ma ketiv bishlomo, (Mishlei 4:3) ki ven hayiti leavi, leavi mammash vadday.

Veim livno yiadenna. bar telesar shenin ulehala, deha nafka mershu desitra achara deizdammenat leh, ma ketiv kemishpat habbanot yaase lah. mahu kemishpat habbanot. tanenan, bechol yoma veyoma, chame kudesha berich hu lehahu yenoka dekae birshu dearla, veihu nafik minah, veitmeshach leve sifra, vetabbar lah, veazil leve kenishta, vetabbar lah. ma avid kudesha berich hu lehahi nishmeta. ail lah leiddara dileh, veyahiv lah mattenan, unevizbezan saggiin, vekashit lah bekishshutin illain, ad zimna deail (Bereshit 147 amud bet) lah lachuppa behahu (go hahu) bar, mittelesar shenin uleela.

Im acheret yikkach lo. hacha it raza derazin, lechakkimin itmesare, veit leodaa bekadmita milla chada. ta chaze, beyoma deshabbeta beshaata deitkaddash yome, nafke nishmatin miggo ilani dechayye, umenashshevan innun nishmatin kaddishin letattae, venayychin behu kol yoma deshabbeta. ulevatar denafik shabbeta, sallekin kullehu nishmatin umitatteran beitrin kaddishin leella. (vechad mitatteran behahu tava illen inun bealav dehahu tivu vadday) uf hachi, kudesha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash, veda hu nishmeta acheret, veaf al gav deda zemina leh, nishmeta dahavat leh bekadmita, sheerah dekadmeta, kesutah veonatah lo yigra, kema deittemar.

Bacha hahu sava kemilkaddemin, veamar ihu lenafsheh, sava sava, kamma yagata leadbeka millin kaddishin illen, vehasheta tema lon beriga chada. i tema detechas alayyhu al innun millin vela tema lon, ha ketiv (Mishlei 3:27) al timna tov mibbealav bihyot leel yadcha laasot.

May al timna tov mibbealav. ella, kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael innun hacha. deha bechol atar demillin deorayyta amrin, kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael innun taman, vetzayyte lon. ucheden, hahu ilana detov vara, beshaata deazlin mittamman, vetzayytu innun millin, hahu sitra detov itgabbar, veistallak leella, vekudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael mitatteran behahu tov, veillen innun bealav dehahu tov.

Sava sava, at amart millin illen, vela yadat i kudesha berich hu hacha, vei illen dekayyme hacha zakkain lemillin illen. la tidchal sava, deha havet bechamma keravin degavrin takkifin, vela dachilat, vehasheta ant dachil, ema milach, deha vadday hacha ihu kudesha berich hu ukkenset yisrael, vezakkain innun illen dehacha. vei lav hachi, la aarana behu, vela sharena beillen millin. ema millulach sava, ema bela dechilu.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:1) Adonai elohay gadalta meod hod vehadar lavashta. Adonai elohay: (9 amud alef, 216 amud bet) da sheruta dimhemnuta, seliku demachashava, vealma deate, raza chada bela piruda. gadalta: da sheruta, yoma kadmaa, veinnun yomin attikin, sitra dimina. meod: da (68 amud bet) hu sitra dismala.

Hod vehadar lavashta: illen teren badde (vaychi 222) aravot. ad hacha, kevan demata lego ilana dechayye, ittammar, vela istallak (sefer acher velo bae) lemeheve beminyayna, begin hahu meod. may meod. semala, dechol anpin diltatta uvichlala anafa merira chada. veal da ittammar hahu ilana dechayye, vela baa lemehevi beminyayna da, ad deahadar kemillekaddemin, veshabbach begavvna achara.
Veamar, ote or kassalma da sheruta (deor)
694: Deyoma kadmaa. note shamayim, hacha itkelil semala, vela amar meod, itkelil semala bimina, lemehve nahir bichlala deshamayim. (Tehillim 104:3) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav, hacha nafik bechedva hahu ilana dechayye, nahar denafik meeden, veishterashu beh bememoy innun tere badde aravot, deinnun gadlin bememoy, hada hu dichtiv (nusach acher hahu ilana dechayye veishterashu beh inun tere badde aravot, deinnun gadlin bememoy vehahu naheraz denafik meeden veda hu) hamekare vammayim aliyyotav. man aliyyotav. illen badde aravot.

Veda hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) veal yuval yeshallach sharashav. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 46:5) nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim. man pelagav. illen innun sharashav. vehachi ikrun, aliyyotav, sharashav, pelagav, kullehu ishterashu beinnun mayin dehahu nahar.

(Tehillim 104:3) hassam avim rechuvo. da michael vegavriel, illen hem avim. hamehallech al kanfe ruach, lemehav asvavta lealma, veda ihu refael. mikkan ulehala ose malachav ruchot vegomer. sava sava, i kol hane yadat, ema vela tidchal, ema milach veyinharun millin defumach. chaddu chavrayyay, vahavu tzayytin bechedva lemilloy kaddishin. amar i sava i sava, bema ayylat garmach, alat beyamma rabba, it lach leshatteta velnafka mittamman.

(Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo, kamma gilgulin attikin hacha, dela itgallun ad haiddana, vechullehu keshot kedka yeot, delet leastaa meorach keshot, afillu kimlo nima. bekadmita (nusach acher hasheta) it leitteara, (95 amud bet) nishmatin degiyyorin kullehu, parchan miggo ginta deeden beorach satim, kad mistallekan mehay alma, nishmathon deka revavcha miggo ginta deeden, lean atar tayyvin.

Ella tanenan, man denatil veachid benichse giyyorin bekadmita, zache behu. uf hachi kol innun nishmatin kaddishin illain, deka zammin lon kudesha berich hu letatta kidkamran, kullehu nafkin lezimnin yedian. (vesallekin) (Bereshit 35 amud bet) begin leishtashea began eden, (dilella) ufagan beinnun nishmatin degiyyorin, man deachid behu meillen nishmatin, (desallekin) achid behu vezache behu, umitlabbeshan behu, vesallekin. vechullehu kayyme behay levusha venachtu go ginta bilvusha da. begin divginta deeden, la kayyeyman tamman, ella bilvusha, kol innun dekayyme tamman.

I tema, divgin hay levusha, garan innun nishmatin mikkol innuga dehava lon bekadmita. ha ketiv, im acheret yikkach lo sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra. beginta kayyme bilvushe da, dekadman leachada behu vezache behu, vechad sallekin leella, mitpashshetan minneh, deha tamman la kayyman (186 amud bet, 210 amud bet, 229, 50, 58, 67) bilvusha.

Bacha hahu sava kemillekaddemin, veamar lenafsheh, sava sava, bevadday it lach lemivke, bevadday it lach leoshada dimin, al kol milla umilla, aval galle kame kudesha berich hu ushechinteh kaddisha, daana biru delibba, uvefulechana dilhon kamena, begin deinnun bealav dechol milla, umitatteran behu.

Kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, kad nachte lehay alma, begin lemishre kol chad al duchetayyhu, deitchazun behu, livni nasha. kullehu nachte mitlabbeshan beinnun nishmatin deka amaran, vehachi alin vezara kaddisha. uvemalbusha da, kayyme leishtabeda minnayyhu behay alma. vechad ishtaavan innun malbushin mimmillin dehay alma, innun nishmatin kaddishin, itteznan (nusach acher ithanun) merecha deka aricha, miggo levushehon illen.

Kudesha berich hu kol millin setimin deihu avid, al lon beorayyta kaddisha, vecholla ishtechach beorayyta, vehahi milla setima galle lah orayyta, umiyyad itlabbesha bilvusha achara, veittammar tamman, vela itgele. vechakkimin deinnun malyayn ayynin, af al gav dehahi milla astim bilvusha (tamman), chaman lah miggo levusha, uveshaata deitgele hahi milla ad la teul bilvusha, raman bah pekichu deena, veaf al gav demiyyad astim, la itavid meenayyhu. (nusach acher minnayyhu)
Bechamma duchetin azhar kudesha berich hu al giyyora, (begin) dezara kaddisha, yizdaharun beh, ulevatar nafik milla setima minnartikah.
695: Vechevan deitgele ahdar lenartikah miyyad, veitlavash tamman.

Kevan deazhar al giyyora bechol innun duchetin, nafak milla minnartikah veitgele, veamar (Shemot 23:9) veattem yedatem et nefesh hager. miyyad alat lenartikah, veahadrat bilvusha veittammerat, dichtiv ki gerim hyitem beeretz mitzrayim, dechashiv kera, divgin deitlebash miyyad, la hava man deashgach bah. behay nefesh hager, yadat nishmeta kaddisha bemillin dehay alma, veithaniat (vaashateabet) minnayyhu.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar vegomer, anan da may hi. ella da hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:13) et kashti natatti beanan. tanenan, dehahu keshet ashlachat levushoy, veyahiv lon lemoshe, (229 amud alef) uvehahu levusha salik moshe letura uminneh chama ma dechama, veithane mikkolla. ad hahu atar, atu innun chavrayyay, veishtetachu kameh dehahu sava, uvachu veamru, ilmale la atena lealma, ella lemishma millin illen mippumach day lan.

Amar hahu sava, (im acheret yikkach lo) chavrayyay, lav begin da bilchodoy sharena milla, deha sava kegini, lav bemilla chada avid kish kish, vela kare, kamma bene alma beirbuveya besachletanu dilhon, vela chaman beorach keshot beorayyta, veorayyta kare bechol yoma binhimu (nusach acher birchimu) legabbayyhu, (divne nasha) vela baan leatava resha.

Veaf al gav daamena, deha orayyta milla nafka minnartikah, veitchaziat zeer, umiyyad ittammarat. hachi hu vadday. uvezimna deitgeliat miggo nartikah veittammerat miyyad, la avdat da, ella leinun deyadin bah, veishtemodan bah.

Mashal lema haddavar dome, lirchimata, deihi (95 amud alef) shappirta bechezu, ushefirta bereva, veihi temirta bitmiru go hechala dilah, veit lah rechima yechidaa, dela yadin beh bene nasha, ella ihu bitmiru. hahu rechima, miggo rechima derachim lah avar litra beta tadir, zakif enoy lechol setar. ihi, yadat deha rechima aschar tera beta tadir, ma avdat, patchat pitcha zeera behahu hechala temira, deihi tamman, ugeliat anpaha legabbe rechima, umiyyad ithadderat veitkasiat. kol innun dahavo legabbe rechima, la chamu vela istakkalu, bar rechima bilchodoy, umeoy velibbeh venafsheh azlu avatrah. veyada demiggo rechimu dirchimat leh, itgeliat legabbeh riga chada, leitteara (sefer acher legabbeh rechimu leh). hachi hu milla deorayyta, la (230 amud bet) itgeliat, ella legabbe rechima. yadat orayyta, dehahu chakkima delibba aschar litra beta kol yoma, ma avdat, geliat anpaha legabbeh, miggo hechala, vearmizat leh remiza, umiyyad ahadrat leatrah veittammerat. kol innun detamman, la yade, vela mistakkele, ella ihu bilchodoy, umeoy velibbeh venafsheh azil avatrah. veal da, orayyta itgeliat veitkassiat, veazlat birchimu legabbe rechimha, leitteara bahadeh rechimu.

Ta chaze, archa deorayyta kach hu, bekadmita kad sharya leitgallaa legabbe bar nash, (beriga) armizat leh birmizu, i yada tav. vei la yada, shadrat legabbeh, vekarata leh peti. veamrat orayyta, lehahu deshadrat legabbeh, imru lehahu peti, deyikrav hacha, veishtae bahadeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 9:4) mi peti yasur henna chaser lev vegomer. kariv legabbah, shariat lemallela immeh, mibbatar parochta defarsa leh, millin lefum archoy, ad deyistakkal zeer zeer, veda hu derasha.

Levatar, tishtae bahadeh, mibbatar shushifa dakik, millin dechida, veda ihu haggada. levatar deihu ragil legabbah, itgeliat legabbeh anpin beanpin, umelilat bahadeh kol razin setimin dilah, vechol archin setimin, dahavo belibbea temirin, miyyomin kadmain. keden
696: Ihu bar nash shelim, baal tora vadday, mare deveta, deha kol razin dilah geliat leh, vela rechikat, vela kassiat minneh kelum.

Amra leh, chamit milla dirmiza deka ramizna lach bekadmita, kach vechach razin havo, kach vechach hu. keden chame, (sefer acher deillain) deal innun millin lav leosafa, velav lemigra minnayyhu. ucheden peshateh dikra, kema deihu, delav leosafa vela lemigra afillu at chad. veal da, beni nasha itzterichu leizdahara, ulemirdaf avatra deorayyta, lemehve rechimin dilah, kema deittemar.

Ta chaze (Shemot 21:10) im acheret yikkach lo, gilgulin demitgalgelan behay kera, kamma ravrevin veillain innun, deha kol nishmatin alin begilgula. vela yadin bene nasha archoy dekudesha berich hu, veheach kayyeyma tikla, vehech itdanu bene nasha bechol yoma, uvechol iddan, vehech nishmatin alin bedina, ad la yetun lehay alma, vehech alin bedina, levatar denafke mehay alma.

Kamma gilgulin, vechamma ovadin setimin, avid kudesha berich hu bahade kamma nishmatin artilain, vechamma ruchin artilain azlin behahu alma, dela alin lefargoda demalka. vechamma almin ithappach behu vealma deithappach bechamma pelian setimin. uvene nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin, vehech mitgalgelin nishmatin, keavna bekusepita. kema deat amer, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala.

(Vehoil itdache legallaa) hasheta it legallaa, deha kol (Vayikra 29 amud alef) nishmatin, meilana ravreva vetakkifa dehu nahar denafik meeden nafke. vechol ruchin, meilana achara zeera nafkin. neshama milleella ruach milletatta, umitchabberan kachada, kegavvna dedachar venukeba. vechad mitchabberan kachada, keden nehirin nehiru illaa. uvechibbura detarvayyhu ikre ner. (Mishlei 20:27) ner Adonai nishmat adam. mahu 250. neshama ruach. veal chibbura detarvayyhu kachada ikre ner, dichtiv ner Adonai nishmat adam.

Neshama veruach: dechar venukeba leanhara kachada, veda belo da, la nehirin, vela ikre ner, vechad mittechabberan kachada, ikre kolla ner. ucheden itattaf neshama beruach, lekayyeyma tamman leella, behechla temira, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:16) ki ruach millefanay yaatof. yitattef la ketiv, ella yaatof. may tama. begin dinshamot ani asiti, tamman leella beginta, behechla temira, itattaf veitlavash neshama beruach, kema deitchaze.

Vechevan divhahu hechala, la have, vela ishtammash ella beruach uneshama, nefesh la ate letamman, (nusach acher mittamman) ella mitlavash behahu ruach tamman, vechad nachta lego gan eden diltatta, (behay alma) itlavash behahu rucha achara daamena, hahu denafik mittamman, vahava mittamman, uvechullehu sharya behay alma, veitlavash behu.

Hahu ruach denafik mehay alma, dela itrabbe (dela itdache) vela itpashat behay alma. azla begilgula, vela ashkach nayycha, itti begilgula bealma, keavna bekusefita, ad deyishkach hahu paroka deyifrok leh, veayyte leh behahu mana mammash, dehava ihu ishtammash beh, vedavik beh tadir rucheh venafsheh, vahavat bat zugeh, rucha berucha, vehahu paroka bani leh kemillekaddemin.

Vehahu rucha deshavak veitdevak behahu mana, la itavid. deha let milla afillu zeera bealma, dela have leh atar veducheta leittammera uleitkannesha tamman, vela itavid lealmin. ubbegin kach, hahu rucha deshavak behahu mana, tamman hu, vadday radif batar ikara visoda dileh, deka nafik minneh, veayyte leh, uvane leh beducheteh, baatar dehahu ruach bat zugeh, (lecha lecha 85 amud bet) denafkat bahadeh, veitbene tamman kemillekaddemin. veda ihu birya chadta hasheta bealma, rucha chadta vegufa chadta.
Vei tema, ruach da hu ma dehava. hachi hu aval la itbene, ella begin hahu rucha achara deka shavak behahu mana,
697: Hacha it razin (sefer acher raza derazin behahu mana.) besifra dechanoch, binyayna da deitbene, la itbene, ella behahu rucha achara deshavik tamman, behahu mana. vechad share leitbenaa, da mashich avatreh dehahu ruach deazil artilaa, umashich leh legabbeh, vetamman tere ruchot deinnun chad. levatar, da ihu ruach, veda ihu neshama, vetarvavyyhu chad.

I zacha leitdakkea kedka yeot, tarvavyyhu innun chad, leitlabbesha behu nishmeta achara illaa. kema deit lishar bene alma, ruach, dezakkain behu nishmatin, innun dekadman veachidan behu, verucha achara milleella. venishmeta kaddisha itlabbesha behu. uf hachi name, middileh mammash it teren ruchin, begin leitlabbesha behu neshama illaa.

Yehe leden gufa achara, deka itbene hasheta chadta, hahu gufa kadmaa deshavak, ma itavid minnih. o hay berekanayyay, o hay berekanayyay. lefum sachletanu debar nash ishtema, dehay kadmaa dela ishtelim bekadmita, itavid, hoil vela zacha. i hachi, lemaggana ishtaddal befikkude orayyta, o afillu bechad minnayyhu. veha anan yadenan, deafillu rekanin shebbeyisrael, kullehu malyayn mitzvot karimmon. vegufa da, af al gav dela ishtelim, leitrabbea, ulemizke ulemisge bealma, pikkudin acharanin deorayyta natar, dela itavidu minneh, vechi lemaggana havo.

Chavrayyay chavrayyay, pekichu enayychu, deha ana yedana, dehachi attun savrin veyadin, (nusach acher salleka datin) dechol innun gufin, tziyyunin innun berekanayyay, dela it lon kiyyuma lealmin. lav hachi, vechas lan leistakkela beillen millin.

Patach sava veamar, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato. man hu bealma, deyachil lemallela gevuran, deavid kudesha berich hu bealma tadir. hahu gufa kadmaa deshavak, la itavid, vekiyyuma lehve leh lezimna deate. deha onsheh saval bechamma zinin, vekudesha berich hu la mekappeach agra deshum biryayn devara, bar innun denafku miggo mehemanuta dileh, vela hava behu tav lealmin. uvar meinnun dela karu bemodim, dehane kudesha berich hu avid minnayyhu biryayn acharanin, begin dela yitbene hahu gufa diyyukena devar nash, vela yekum lealmin. aval hane lav hachi.

Ma aved kudesha berich hu. i hahu ruach, zache leittakna behay alma, behahu gufa achara, me avid kudesha berich hu. hahu paroka deka parik leh, hahu ruach dileh deka ail tamman, veshataf vearav behahu ruach dehava behahu mana, vadday la itavid, uma itavid, deha telat ruchin tamman, (sefer acher behahu gufa achara beh yakum uma avid kudesha berich hu. 401 chaze hahu paroka deka parik leh. ruach dileh ha ail haman veshavik vashechaf vaerev behahu mana. vehahu rucha kadmaa dehu behahu mana veitdabbak beh vadday ishtaar tamman velo itavid uvegin kach hahu rucha deshavak behahu mana veitdabbak tamman hu radif batar ikara dileh visoda dileh deka nafik minneh vaayytayh leh uvene leh beducheteh baatar dahavavt bat zugeh. ha telat ruchin tamman) chad, dehava behahu mana, veishtear tamman. vechad, hahu deitmeshach tamman dehava artilaa. vechad, hahu deail tamman hahu paroka, veitarav behu. lemehve bitlat ruchin i efshar. uma itavid.

Ella, kach innun gevuran illain, deavid kudesha berich hu. hahu rucha deail tamman hahu paroka, beh itlavash hahi nishmeta, baatar dilvusha degiyyore, (vehu) vehahu rucha artilaa, detav tamman leitbenaa, lehve levusha lenishmeta illaa. vehahu ruach dehava bekadmita, deishtear behahu mana, parach mittamman. vekudesha berich hu azmin leh atar, bego razin kavvin detinara, devatar kitfoy degan eden, veittammar tamman. veistallak lehahu gufa kadmaa, dehu bekadmita. uvehahu ruach yekum hahu gufa, veda ihu chad deinnun teren, deka amena (leella).

Aval hahu gufa, ad dela yekum, onsheh sagya deha begin dela zacha leitrabbea, nachte leh lego (tikkunin 79 amud alef) adama, desamich learka. veitdan tamman. ulevatar sallekin leh lehay tevel. hasheta nachit, vehasheta salik, ha salik, veha nachit, let leh shechichu bar beshabbate, uveyomin tavin uvereshe yarche.
698: Admat, meadama. afar mittevel. veal illen ketiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim miysheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot ulediron olam. kol illen dela zachu leittakna aval i zacha hahu rucha artilaa, detav kemillekaddemin, leittakna. zakkaa ihu, deha hahu rucha deittemar beh, deittemmar betinara, yittakkan behahu gufa kadmaa. veal illen ketiv ele lechayye olam veelle lacharafot vegomer. kol innun dela zachu leittakna.

Veillen innun gevuran illain, demalka illaa kaddisha, vela itavid kelum. afillu haval defuma atar veducheta it leh, vekudesha berich hu avid mine ma deavid. vaafillu milla devar nash, vaafillu kala, la have berekanayyay, vaatar veducheta it lehu lecholla.
Hay deitbene hasheta, venafak lealma birya chadta, let leh bat zug. veal da la machrize, deha bat zugeh itavidat minneh, bat zugeh dahavat leh, itavidat immeh, veachuha avuha.

Sava sava, ma avdat, tav hava lach shetika, sava sava, ha amena dealat beyamma rabba, bela chavlin, uvela digla, ma taaved. i tema detisllak leella, la tichol. i tema detechut letatta, ha imka dithoma rabba, ma taaved. i sava i sava, la it lach leahaddera laachora. beidanin illen, la havet, vela itregilat, leitchallesha betukefach, deha yadat, devar nash achara bechol dara da, la al bearba beamika da deant tamman.

Bereh deyochay yada leistammera archoy, vei al beyamma amika, ashgach bekadmita, hech yaavar bezimna chada, vishotet beyamma, ad la yeul veant sava, la ashgacht bekadmita. hasheta sava, hoil veant tamman, la techolash betukefach, la tishbok kol archach, limshatteta limina velismala, learka ulefuteyay, leamka uleruma, la tidchal. sava sava, ittakkaf betukfach, kamma gavrin takkifin tavart betukfehon, vechamma keravin natzacht.

Bacha, patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo beyom chatunnatto uveyom shimchat libbo. hay kera ukemuha, vehachi hu. aval tzeena ureena, vechi man yachil lemechome bammelech shelomo, dehu malka dishlama dileh, veha satim hu, mikkol chele meromin dilella, behahu atar, (Yeshayahu 64:3) deayin la raata elohim zulatcha. veat amart tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo. vetu, deha kavod dileh, kullehu malache illae shaali veamre, ayye mekom kevodo.

Ella, ma deamar tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo, baatara ketiv, vela ketiv uvaatara dechol man dechame hahu attara, chame noam malka dishlama dileh. sheittera lo immo, ha tanenan, kare lah bat, vekare lah achot, kare lah em, vecholla ihu. vecholla have, man deyistakkal veyinda behay, yinda chachmeta yakkira.

Hasheta ma avid, i ema, raza setima da, la itzterich legallaa. i la ema, yishtaarun zakkain illen, yatmin mehay raza, nafal hahu sava al anpoy, veamar, (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet. mana dahavat letatta, hech yitavid leella, balah dehava leella, hech yithappech vahava letatta. bat zugeh itavidat immeh. tavavha al tavavha. achuha avuha. i avuha dekadmeta, yifrok leh, yeot, aval achuha deleheve avuha, vechi la tavavha ihu da. alma behippucha ihu. vadday illain letatta, vetattain leella.

Ella, (Daniel 2:20) lehve shemeh di elaha mevarach min alma vead alma di chachmeta ugevureta dileh hi. vehu mehashene iddanayya vezimnaya vegomer yada ma bechashocha unehora immeh shara. ta chazi, man dishre binhora, la yachil leistakkela ulemechome bechashocha. aval kudesha berich hu lav hachi,
699: Yada ma vachashocha, af al gav dinhora immeh shara. miggo nehora, istakkal bachashocha, veyada kol ma detamman.

Hacha, it leakdema bekadmita, milla chada, deamru kadmae, beinnun chezve lelya. ditnan, man deate al immeh bechelma, yetzappe labbina. dichtiv, (Mishlei 2:3) ki im labbina tikra, hacha it leistakkela, i begin deihi em yeot, vahava leh lemichtav hachi, deman dechama immeh bechelma, yizke labbina. aval man deate al immeh amay.
Ella raza illaa ihu, begin deithappach vesalik mittatta leella. bera hava bekadmita, kevan desalik leella, ithappach ilana, veitavid ihu mealma illaa, veshalit alah, vezache labbina.

Bekadmita kad salik enash 43 (98 amud alef) shenin, ma ketiv, (Tehillim 2:7) Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha, keden ihu letatta minah. kevan desalik alah, hay ihu mealma illaa. deha istallak bedarga deyosef, veda (sefer acher vadday) zache labbina.

Uf hachi hay mana, bekadmita ihu hava bedarga deyosef, baal ilana tattaa, kayyeyma biruteh, veshalit aleh, deha kol nukeba, bediyyukena denukeba ilana tattaa kayyeyma. kevan deihu la baa lekayyeyma behahu darga deyosef, vela itkeyaym leshammesha beh, uleappasha bealma, ulemebad toladin, keden nachit letatta, veitavidat ihi immeh. vehahu paroka, yarit yaruta deyosef, dehava hu bekadmita veihu nachit letatta.

Kevan denachit letatta, keden itkayyaym beh, Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha. ithappach ilana, ma dehava techoteh veihu shalit aleh, ithaddar veshalit hahu ilana aleh, veihu nachit letatta. kevan deihu nachit letatta, hahu deyarit yaruta atar deyosef, avoy ikre, avoy have vadday, kolla ihu al tekkuneh vadday kedka yeot.

Bekadmita hava mealma didchura, veha itakkar mittamman, vehasheta ihu mealma denukeba. uma dehava ihu shalit alah, shalta ihi aleh, veithaddar lemehve bealma denukeba. veal da let leh bat zug kelal. vela machrize aleh, al nukeba. deha mealma denukeba ithaddar ihu.

Vehahu gufa kadmaa deshavak, ilmale yindeun veyistakkelun beni alma, tzaara deit leh, kad yitakkar mealma didchura, veithaddar lealma denukeba. yindeun, deha let tzaara bealma, kehahu tzaara. bat zug let leh, deha la kayyeyma beatar didchura. la machrize aleh, al nukeba, deha mealma denukeba ihu. vei it leh bat zug, havi berachame, iarat bahade (nusach acher bechad) nukeba, dead kean la it lah bar zug. veal da tanenan, dilma yekaddemenu acher berachamim. acher tenan. vecholla ihu al tekkuneh.

Veal da ketiv (Vayikra 22:13) uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha. uvat kohen, ha okimna milla da. almana, mehahu gufa kadmaa. ugerusha, dela alat lefargoda demalka, dechol innun dela kayyme bealma didchura, la it lehu beh chulaka. hu ishtemit veakar garmeh mealma didchura, la it leh chulaka beh veal da ihi gerusha. vezera en lah, dei hava lah zera, la itakkar minneh, vela hava nachit lealma denukeba.

Veshava el bet aviha, man bet aviha. da alma denukeba, dehahu alma bet aviha ikre, vehahu mana dehava ittakkan leishtammesha beh, ithappach veihu nachit letatta, vehahu mana salik leella. kinureha, kehahu zimna dichtiv, ani hayyom yelidticha, yelidticha vadday, yashuv lime alumav, kema dehava (bekadmita) mittelesar shenin uleella.
I zachat leittakna, hoil veshava el bet aviha, millechem aviha tochel,
700: Titannag mehahu innuga. dealma denukeba, deachle minnahama deabbirim, denachit milleella. aval leistakkela uleithane bema deithanun shear tzaddikayyay, la yachla begin dehava zar letamman. veal da la achil kodesh aval achil teruma, deihu yativ bealma denukeba.

Umiggo deihu mealma denukeba, la achil leh ella ballayla, dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:7) uva hashshamesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim ki lachmo hu. deha kodesh deihu mealma didchura, la itachil ella bayyom. begine kach (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato, (Bereshit 31 amud bet) sheruta illaa dechol alma didchura, (59 amud alef) kodesh ihu, uma desalik beh, bakkodesh yisrael hava, uvegini kach kodesh yisrael laAdonai rishit tevuato.

Kad ruchin pekidan, beinnun zimnin defakdin leve kivre, innun la pakdin, deha la zachan lealma dekodesh, dichtiv, (Vayikra 22:10) vechol zar lo yochal kodesh. vei la zacha hahu rucha leittakna kedka yeot, kevan deahadar begilgula, afillu behahu atar, bitruma la achil, vezar ikre, afillu lealma tattaa vela achil bah. ad hacha beraza da.

Sava sava, kevan dishriat leshatteta beyamma rabba, zil birutach, lechol sitrin deyamma. hasheta it legallaa, deha amena, dehay paroka kad ate, al gabbe hahu mana, deka amena, ail tamman, vedavik tamman rucha (dealma) dileh behahu mana vela itavid kelum, afillu haval defuma, yeot hu vechach hu. sava sava, i tema utegale, ema bela dechilu.

Shear bene nasha dealma, deka mistalleke minneh, veha yedana, deruach dileh shavik behahi itteta dahavat leh, verucha ail tamman, ma itavid mehahu ruach. vei nasva hay itteta, uf hachi, ma itavid mehahu ruach deshavak bah balah kadmaa, deha gevar achara ate alah.

Leitkayyeyma ruach beruach la efshar, deha hay deate alah hasheta, ruach ail bah. vechen hahu kadmaa deistalik, ruach ail bah. hahu kadmaa deistallak benin havo leh, veda dehashta lav paroka ihu, ruach deshavak hahu kadmaa behahu mana, veata hay achara veail bah ruach, vadday la yachle tarvayyhu leitkayyeyma behahu gufa deitteta kachada, i nima deitavid, i efshar, ma itavid minneh.

Uf hachi i ihi la itnesivat, hahu rucha deshavak bah balah, may itavid minnih. i nima deitavid, lav hachi. kol da tzarich legallaa hasheta. sava sava, chame ma avdat, uvamme ailat garmach. kum sava, arim diglach. kum sava, veashpil garmach kame marach.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Tehillim 131:1) Adonai lo gava libbi velo ramu enay vegomer. david malka amar da, begin dehava malka illaa, veshallita al kol malchin illain, veshallitin deit mimmizrach vead maarav, vela salik al libbeh leastaa mearcha, vetadir shafil libbeh kame mareh, vechad hava lae beorayyta, hava mitgabbar kearya, veenoy tadir meichin beara, middechilu demareh. vechad hava azil ben amma, la hava beh gassut rucha kelal.

Veal da ketiv, Adonai lo gava libbi vegomer, lo gava libbi, af al gav daana malka shallita al kol shear malchin dealma. velo ramu ene, bezimna daana kayyeyma kammach, lae beorayyta. velo hillachti bigdolot uveniflaot mimmenni, beshaata daana azil ben amma. vei david malka amar hachi, shear bene alma al achat kamma vechamma. vaana kamma ana shafil libba, umaich ena kame malka kaddisha. vechas li, divmillin kaddishin deorayyta, yerom libbay. bacha vedimoy naflin al dikneh.
Amar, sava lae bechela, kamma shappiran dimin al diknach, kema dehava shappir mishcha tava, kad hava nachit al dikna desava tava deaharon. ema milach sava
701: Deha malka kaddisha hacha. shear bene nasha dealma, deka istalaku minneh, veshavku rucha behahu mana, dahavo mishtammeshe beh, veitnesivat, veata achara veail behahu mana rucha achara, ma itavid mehahu kadmaa, kema deittemar.

Ta chazi, kamma illain gevuran demalka kaddisha, deka avid, uman yachil lemallela lon. kad hay balah tinyayna, ate veail rucha behahu mana, rucha kadmaa, mekatrega behay ruach deal, vela ityayshshevan kachada.

Uvegine kach, itteta la ityayshshevat kedka yeot, bahade balah tinyayna, begin derucha kadmaa mechashkesha bah, ucheden ihi dechirat leh tadir, uvachat aleh, o itanchat aleh, deha rucha dileh, mechashkesha bimaha kechivya, umekatrega bahade ruach achara, deal bah mibbalah tinyana. ad zeman saggi mekatregin da beda.

Vei abar da deal, lehahu (ittearu) dehava kadmaa (levatar), da kadmaa nafik veazil leh. ulezimnin, dedache da kadmaa lehahu tinyayna, veitavid leh mekatrega, ad deappik leh mealma. veal da tanenan, demitteren ulehala, la yissav bar nash lehay itteta, deha malach hammavet ittakkaf bah, uvene alma la yadin, deha rucha kevan deittakkaf veka natzach lehahu rucha achara tinyayna, mikkan ulehala la yitarav bar nash achara bahadah.

Chavrayyay, ha yedana divaatar da it lechu lemikshe, velema i hachi la mit bedina hay tinyayna, vela dayynin leh milleella. ta chazi, kolla ihu bedina, deyintzach peloni lifloni o dela yekatreg aleh peloni lifloni. uman denasiv armalta, keman deal beyamma, beruchin takkifin, belo chavlin, vela yada i yaavar bishlam, i yitba go tehome.

Vei da deal hahu rucha tinyayna, ittakif venatzach lehahu kadmaa, hahu kadmaa nafak mittamman veazil leh. lean atar azil leh, uma itavid. sava sava ma avdat. chashavt ditmallel zeer, venafkat lehay, ha alat baatar dela al bar nash achara, min yoma dedoeg vaachitofel avdu bayayn illen, beinnun arba mea bayiyi, dahavo baan al migaddela defarach baavira, vela ativ alayyhu bar nash, ad deata shelomo malka, uvirer lon kol chad vechad al tekkuneh. sava sava, raza illaa dehava temira, atit legallaa, ma avadit.

Sava sava, bekadmita hava lach lenatra archach, vetistakkal bereshach. aval hasheta, lav shaata leittammera. sava, ahdar betukfach. hahu ruach denafak, lean azil. bacha veamar, chavrayya, kol hani bichyayn deka bachena, lav beginayychu hu, ella dachilna lemare alma, degallena archin setimin, belo reshu. aval galle kame kudesha berich hu, dela likara dili avidna, vela likara deabba, aval reuti lefulechana dileh, vaana chamena, yekara dechad minnayychu, behahu alma, veachara yedana dehachi hu. aval la galle kamay, vehasheta chamena.

Tanenan, dachyayn gavra mikkame gavra, bechamma archin setimin (vayyelech 284 amud alef) itdachyayn. hahu rucha kadmaa, deitdache mikkame hahu tinyayna, lean azil. hahu rucha, nafik veazil, umeshatteta bealma, vela yedia, veazil lego kivra dehahu bar nash, umittamman meshatteta bealma, veitchazze bechelma livni nasha, vechaman bechelma diyyukena dehahu bar nash, veoda lon millin lefum archeh dehahu ruach kadmaa, deka itmeshach mineh, kema deihu behahu alma, hachi meshatteta hay, veoda behay alma.

Vehachi azil umeshatteta bealma, ufakdat tadir lehahu kivra, ad (achore haddaf) zimna deruchot pakdan legabbe kivrayyhu degufin. keden, hay rucha, itchabbar behahu ruach dileh, veitlavash beh, veazil leh. kad al leducheteh, itpashat minneh. veducheta it leh (beinnun ruchin began eden)
702: Beinnun hechalin degan eden, o levar, lefum archoy dechol chad vechad, vetamman ittammar.

Vechad ruchin pakdan lehay alma, demetin nizkakin legabbe chayyin, la nizkakin ella behahu meshichu derucha, uveh itlavash rucha achara. vei tema, i hachi, toalta ihu lerucha, vehay itteta toalta avdat lecholla. lav hachi, deilmale la itnesivat legabbe achara, vehay rucha kadmaa la mitdachyay mikkame hay gavra ochora, toalta achara hava leh, begavvna achara, vela yehe lae bealma, kema dehave, vela yizdakkek legabbe chayyin dehay alma, kema dehave meshatteta hacha vehacha.

I hachi ziuuga tinyayna dehay itteta, la have milleella. veat amart deitdachyay gevar mikkame gevar, vaamena dehay balah tinyayna, denasiv leitteta da, ihu bat zugeh mammash. vehahu kadmaa lav bar zugeh mammash hava. vehay tinyayna dilay hava, vechad mata zimneh, itdachyay da mikkammeh. vaday hachi hu, deha la itdachyay hahu ruach kadmaa, dehava behay itteta. ella begin dehay tinyayna, deihu bar zugah. (davar ihi bat zugeh) (hay tinyayna).

Vechol innun tinyaynin, deitdachyayn mikkame kadmain. kadmain havo bene zugayyhu, vela hane. uvegin kach, la it lon kiyyuma bahadayyhu, veitdachyay ruach tinyayna mikkame rucha kadmaa. uvegin kach, man denasiv armalta, karenan aleh, (Mishlei 7:23) velo yada ki venafsho hu. (Mishlei 1:17) ki chinnam mezora harashet vegomer vela yedia i hi bat zugeh mammash i lav.

Armalta dela nesivat, af al gav deate bar zugah, veihi la baat leitnasseva, kudesha berich hu la kayif lah min dina, vekudesha berich hu azmin lehahu bar nash itteta achara, vela alat bedina kehay (sefer acher velet aleh bi dina behay) behahu alma, veaf al gav delet lah bar, deha itteta la itpakkedat appirya ureviyya, kema deukemuha.

Itteta da dela itnesivat zimna tinyayna, hahu ruach deshavak bah balah ma itavid minneh. yativ tamman teresar yarche, uvechol lelya velelya, nafik ufakda lenafsha, veithaddar leatreh. levatar teresar yarche, deka istallak dina dehahu gavra, deha kol innun teresar yarche, ha rucha itkafyay baatzivu kol yoma. levatar teresar yarche, nafik mittamman, veazil vekayyeyma litra gan eden, (achore haddaf) ufakda lehay alma, legabbe hahu mana, denafik minneh. vechad hay itteta istallakat mealma, hahu ruach nafik veitlavash behahu ruach dilah, vezachat beh legabbe balah, venaharin tarvavyyhu, kedka yeot, bechibbura chada.

Kevan deatena lehay atar, hasheta it legallaa archin setimin, demare alma, la yadin behu bene nasha. vechullehu azlin beorach keshot, kema deat amer (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu bam ufoshim yikkashlu bam. uveni nasha la yadin, vela mashgichin, kamma innun illain, ovadin dekudesha berich hu, vechamma meshanyayn innun, uveni alma la yadin, vechullehu beorach keshot, dela satan limina velismala.

Hane demitgalgelin, deka itterachu betiruchin mehahu alma, velet lon bat zug. bat zug deka mizdavvevgan behay alma, mean innun, innun nashin, deka mizdavvevgan bahadayyhu behay alma. deha (tarich la velet leh bat zug keinnun guvrin dela tareykev veka mizdavvevgan bahade nasheyyhav) lechullehu bene nasha, it lon bat zug, bar mehay.

Chamu hasheta, kamma innun ravrevin veillain gevuran dileh. tanenan, man dimtarech itteteh kadmaa, madbecha achit aloy dimin. madbecha amay. ella, ha amena, dechol nashin dealma bediyyukena dehay mizbach kayyme, veal da (nasha 184 amud alef) yartan innun sheva birkan, dechullehu mikkenset yisrael innun. vei ihu
703: Metarach lah, ahdar avna (nusach acher demadbecha illaa) legirona. may tama. begin demitchabberan tiruchin bahade hadade.
